parameters.content:
## Reputation Radar — setup
1. Create the Google Sheet (tabs: Mentions, Reply Queue, Weekly Report, Execution Log, Errors) — see SETUP.md.
2. Connect credentials: Google Sheets, Google Gemini API, Telegram, Gmail (weekly report email).
3. Paste your Sheet ID, Reddit search feed URLs, Trustpilot URL and Google Places API key where marked YOUR_*.
4. Test with Manual Trigger first. Only then activate the schedules.

## Hard rules (do not remove)
- Draft replies are NEVER auto-posted. A negative mention only creates a
  draft in the Reply Queue sheet + a Telegram alert for Siva to approve.
- Sentiment comes from the actual mention text — never invented mentions.
- X/Twitter has no free public feed: the X source below is a placeholder
  HTTP call that must be replaced with Siva's own X API access (see SETUP.md).

## Memory / learning
The Mentions sheet is the memory layer: every mention, its sentiment and
its date is logged, so the Monday weekly report can show real trends
instead of re-fetching history. No live DB — Sheets only.

nodes.notes: Free-tier Gemini model. Connect your Google Gemini API credential here.

nodes.name: Analyse Sentiment

options.systemMessage: You are Siva's reputation analyst. Classify the sentiment of each mention about Siva or his projects (AI SDR Agent, Voice Receptionist, HireMind AI, SecureFlow, AuditMind). Judge ONLY from the mention text provided — never invent context. For negative mentions, draft a short, calm, professional reply in Siva's voice (direct, honest, no defensiveness) that acknowledges the point and offers a next step. The reply is a DRAFT for Siva to approve — it is never posted automatically.

nodes.notes: Gemini sentiment analysis. Negative mentions get a draft reply — never an auto-post.

nodes.name: Negative?
nodes.notes: Only negative mentions go to the approval queue. Everything else is just logged.

nodes.name: Telegram: Negative Mention
nodes.notes: HUMAN APPROVAL STEP. The draft sits in the Reply Queue sheet until Siva approves it.
